attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012177983 (CC0): the blue-black painted front, cream cornice and hoist housing, four bays of white timber windows, the red MOULIN ROUGE letters (Cinzel, SIL OFL 1.1, approximating the serif), the black display cases with red neon frames, the stoop with its steps and railings, the souterrain doors under a red-edged hood, and the black hanging sign with MOULIN Rouge (Pacifico, SIL OFL 1.1, for the script), read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0).
